primary_definition: mean over examples of (layman-term hit rate) x (1 if every critical-span category is preserved else 0)

criteria.beats_noop: hybrid or sipg: SARI > copy SARI, paired-bootstrap 95% CI excludes 0
criteria.safe: critical-span preservation = 100% on the stress set AND clinician-sample hallucination <= 2% (the latter needs human evaluation)
criteria.beats_rules: sipg layman hit% > rules, Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, AND SARI not significantly worse
criteria.rl_earns_keep: sipg > greedy on SARI or layman hit%, Holm-adjusted p < 0.05, on real data
criteria.fallback_works: fallback% > 0 (real or adversarial inputs) AND fallback outputs 100% critical-span preserved
